advisory.finding: No test asserts that a refused sidecar emit leaves NO durable event in the store. The PR's central contract is that the audit record was BLOCKED and NOT written, but every test asserts only stderr wording ("WITHOUT", "secret screen") and the returned bool — none reads the ticket's event dir to confirm the COMPLETION_VERDICT / REVIEW_RESULT event is absent. A regression where the screen is bypassed (or the record partially lands) would keep the stderr warning path unchanged and pass all four tests.
merged_from: No test asserts the SecretScreenRefused IS-A CommandError subclass relationship — the diff's core backward-compatibility guarantee ("every existing except CommandError and the exit-1/returncode contract still catch it unchanged"). If a future edit reparents SecretScreenRefused off CommandError, every existing `except CommandError` caller silently changes behavior and no test in this suite fails (the new tests catch it via the sidecar's dedicated first handler, which sits before the generic handler regardless of the base class).
